<h2>Validate Model Store Freshness</h2>

<h3>Description</h3>

<p>Aborts when resolved store-freshness findings still contain a blocking
finding: an outdated, never-built, or unexpectedly errored target that no
ledger row covers, a changed configuration, or a stale ledger row.
</p>


<h3>Usage</h3>

<pre><code class='language-R'>validate_model_store_freshness(data_findings_resolved)
</code></pre>


<h3>Arguments</h3>

<table role = "presentation">
<tr><td><code id="data_findings_resolved">data_findings_resolved</code></td>
<td>
<p>Output of [apply_model_store_freshness_ledger()].</p>
</td></tr>
</table>


<h3>Value</h3>

<p>Invisibly, 'data_findings_resolved' when nothing blocks.
</p>


<h3>See Also</h3>

<p>[diagnose_model_store_freshness()],
[apply_model_store_freshness_ledger()]
</p>


<h3>Examples</h3>

<pre><code class='language-R'>validate_model_store_freshness(
  data_findings_resolved = tibble::tibble(
    store_path_relative = "Data/targets/a/pipeline",
    target_name = "always_cued_target",
    finding_type = "always_cued_not_evaluated",
    resolution_status = "informational"
  )
)
</code></pre>

</main>
